The retained recursor-type pair leaves a current acceptance premise unresolved and has exact reusable bytes, source archive and historical controls. The trust-assumption candidate may later reuse axiom tooling but lacks its exact reporting contract.

The dependent-term all-accept result supplies no concrete upstream action. Acceptance impact remains local and read-only; even a reproduced difference would require a separate current duplicate and maintainer review plus exact external authorization.

Acceptance impact reuses the semantic-import source analysis, retained one-scalar pair, exact Kiota archive and the completed supervised receipt patterns. This is more immediately bound than creating a new two-path trust-reporting model.

Exact offline source materialization, build and four-cell reproduction are feasible local work inside acceptance impact. Trust-assumption work first needs its exact toolchain mechanisms, expected assumption sets and observable report paths bound in a staged protocol.

candidates.rationale: READY and unstarted under a two-stage plan. Stage 1 uses only the exact retained candidate/control, archived Kiota 9fa2c297 source and official reference in four fixed cells.
